The '''Miner's Union Hall''' was an office building in [[Elesa]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], at some point before [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. It was the seat of the [[Elesa Mining Union]] which was at that point managed by [[Geon Justic]].

At some point, former podracer-turned-criminal accomplice [[Ree]] visited the Union Hall to meet with and bribe Justic. Soon afterward, other visitors tracking Ree and his boss, [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kaeline Ungasan]], entered the Hall and questioned Justic about his previous meeting. After the fourth party visited, Justic decided to leave on vacation.
